title: Norse Cove

services.name: Nordic Huts
services.desc: We have 13 tent sites that sit on raised platforms, keeping you level, and dry while allowing the natural vegetation below to remain unharmed. 2 of our sites are on the ground to allow for larger tents. Each site has its own campfire ring and picnic table. All tent sites are labelled with a "T" on the map at the bottom of this page to help you find the best spot for you! We have 6 sites that are on the ocean, these are non-serviced sites for small to mid-sized trailers and camper-vans. The maximum length for vehicles is 26 feet. services.name: Kayak rental
services.desc: The Sterling Reflection is a versatile and playful sea kayak designed for paddlers seeking exceptional control and maneuverability. Measuring 16 feet in length, it features pronounced rocker and finely tapered ends, allowing for quick acceleration and responsive handling. This design makes the Reflection particularly adept at navigating dynamic waters, such as surf zones, tidal races, and rock gardens. Despite its compact size, the Reflection offers ample storage capacity for camping essentials, making it perfect for day trips and multi-day adventures. The kayak's keyhole cockpit, foam seat, and low-profile thigh braces provide a snug and responsive fit, enhancing the paddler's connection
